title: Column infrastructure band
description: A long deep-teal card inset from the page edges on a dot grid: a cyan mono eyebrow, a 48px pale-cyan gradient headline and a muted paragraph beside a layered-stack art slot whose labelled hairlines pull together as you scroll (the middle layers fade out and one merged label fades in). Below, each product gets a title, a paragraph and a curl snippet on the left while one panel stays pinned on the right, crossfading to the art and feature tiles of whichever product is in view. Phones show each product's panel under its snippet.
notes: sets the dark class on its own card, so the theme's dark values apply even on a light page; under a theme whose dark mode is light-ish it loses its contrast
needs JavaScript to switch the pinned panel with the product in view (hydrate: visible); without it the first product's panel stays
the stack art and each product's panel art are media slots; empty, they're plain translucent surfaces
